program='''def transform(grid):
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    marker = next(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0, 3))
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(rows) for c in range(cols) if grid[r][c] == marker]
    min_r = min(r for r, c in points)
    max_r = max(r for r, c in points)
    min_c = min(c for r, c in points)

    height, width = max_r - min_r + 1, max_c - min_c + 1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for dr in range(rows - height + 1):
        for dc in range(cols - width + 1):
            if all(grid[dr + r][dc + c] == 0 for r, c in shape):

program='''def transform(grid):
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for value in row:
            if value != 0:
                counts[value] = counts.get(value, 0) + 1
    marker = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(rows) for c in range(cols) if grid[r][c] == marker]
    min_r = min(r for r, c in points)
    max_r = max(r for r, c in points)
    min_c = min(c for r, c in points)
    max_c = max(c for r, c in points)
    shape = [(r - min_r, c - min_c) for r, c in points]
    height, width = max_r - min_r + 1, max_c - min_c + 1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for dr in range(rows - height + 1):
        for dc in range(cols - width + 1):
            if all(grid[dr + r][dc + c] == 0 for r, c in shape):
                for r, c in shape:
                    out[dr + r][dc + c] = marker
    return out
'''
